basis: RM65Scene / rm65_model_bridge (not the older Aloha Gate E protocols)

translation_range.simulation: move_delta: 3 finite numbers in meters; no numeric step cap in ModelAdapter
translation_range.current_real: 3 finite metre deltas; no planner axis/norm cap

rotation_range.simulation: move_delta preserves orientation; move_pose accepts all unit wxyz quaternion orientations (norm tolerance 0.001)
rotation_range.previous_real: work-frame RPY delta per axis <=5 degrees
rotation_range.current_real: Finite RPY radian delta; componentwise target_rpy=current_rpy+rotation_rpy_rad, no planner cap/wrapping

gripper_semantics.simulation: continuous opening 0..1; 1=open/0=close; simulated master angle=-0.91*(1-opening), contact latch/preload enabled
gripper_semantics.current_real: Normalized input passed unchanged to original RmArm.set_gripper_position; original driver uses integer wire units int(opening*1000). No additional rounding/rescaling of proposal.

frame_semantics.simulation: world origin from temporary stand/table scene; position=mean distal pad faces; orientation=Link6 flange; offset determined from simulated geometry
frame_semantics.current_real: explicit realman:left:work:World + realman:left:tool:Arm_Tip; active controller tool pose; no pad-center/world registration inferred
frame_semantics.reason: simulation assembly explicitly not laboratory calibration; no reliable pad-center transform supplied

planning.simulation: IK + OMPL/FCL full path and joint limits; simulated geometry
planning.current_real: RealMan API2 rm_movej_p joint-space interpolation to the unchanged target pose at v=1%; existing controller limits unchanged; no harness IK/projection

extra_real_constraints: finite exact action schema and explicit unchanged work/tool frames
one proposal per observation; up to one arm and one gripper command, serialized arm then gripper; no retry
controller/robot/gripper error or command/API/camera/state failure stops
latest observation TTL180s (simulation same TTL); fresh state before dispatch
RPY conversion failure stops as adapter failure
not_migrated: simulation absolute pad-center move_pose (unknown physical transform)
simulation chunks up to3; real one command then observe
simulation finite hold and grasp contact-latch/reflex
simulation scene workspace coordinates not copied into laboratory
execution_policy: Unchanged proposal values; one semantic action may command both channels; skip gripper only if actual feedback already satisfies requested state; no IK/projection/retries
